method: Flagged is true when OSV.dev lists any advisory for this exact version, whatever its severity; highest_severity is the highest among them ("unknown" when the records carry none), a MAL- id marks a malicious-package advisory. A typosquat or install-script finding alone does not set flagged. Advisory text is from OSV.dev and the databases it republishes, among them the GitHub Advisory Database (CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/advisories) and the PyPA advisory database (CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/pypa/advisory-database); summaries are shortened. Release, maintainer and script facts: the npm registry document. Typosquat: Damerau-Levenshtein distance 1 or 2, separator and word-order variants, and unscoped copies, against a bundled list of the most-downloaded npm packages. Flags are factual signals from public records, not a verdict.
